_readme: Single source of truth for every controlled vocabulary in the catalogue.
Read by tests/data-schema.test.js here. The ingestion pipeline (its own
branch/repo now) keeps its own copy of vocab.py -- a taxonomy change
needs editing both, the same hand-syncing this file was originally
built to avoid when the lists lived in three copies -- core.py,
data-schema.test.js, and the README's prose -- with nothing keeping
them in sync.
Two groups, deliberately flat rather than nested so neither consumer
needs a path walk:
* taxonomy facets (categories..subject_types) -- derived at ingestion
by core.classify_item(), asserted on every item by both suites.
* content-workflow enums (tea_voice_..onward) -- hand-curated editorial
state, currently asserted only by the JS suite. Listed here anyway so
there is one place to look, not two.
Ordering is preserved from the original definitions. Membership checks
don't care, but a stable order keeps diffs reviewable.
twist_categories_deferred is policy, not data integrity: 'looted' and
'repatriation_dispute' are the real spec's values but are deliberately
PAUSED (not removed) pending careful thought on tone for genuinely
sensitive political/cultural subject matter. A test enforces the pause.
